items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was another local band called Barney Rapp, not Barney Rupp. Barney Rapp. These were leading white dance bands in the Cincinnati area.

ctx.x: This guy Paul Trask was a nationally known arranger, had his own band based in Cincinnati. There was another local band called Barney Rapp, not Barney Rupp. Barney Rapp. These were leading white dance bands in the Cincinnati area. There were a few others whose names I can’t recall.
Was there any level of contact between the white and black musicians in Cincinnati?
